description: Week 32 (2026-11-07; Harrison, 2026-11-07: BUD-E-Whisper and Whisper medium as the fifth and sixth encoders, to see how far the Whisper heads go): BUD-E-Whisper's encoder (laion/BUD-E-Whisper; Whisper Small fine-tuned by LAION to caption emotional speech, Whisper Small's shape), frozen, reading the 80-band log-mel spectrogram its own feature extractor makes; each of its 13 layers' mean vector per utterance (over the encoder frames that cover the utterance's own samples, as for large-v3) with the SVM of night 30's classical_pretrained_whisper_large_v3_pooled4_1, whose settings this sweep keeps except the feature set. Seed 1. The layer with the highest mean validation macro accuracy over the 5 folds is chosen, a tie to the lower layer (RULE_week32_addendum9.txt part N). How the results are read is fixed in RULE_week32_addendum9.txt (analyses/week32_prep_20261102) before any run. Runs on CPUs in the classical environment.
